subject.title: [Feature]: Collapse a completed turn's work behind a "Worked for X" rollup in Control UI chat

question: Should completed Control UI turns collapse their intermediate commentary and tool activity by default, using the rollup itself as the visible completion signal?
rationale: This changes the default information hierarchy for every completed web chat turn; tests can validate mechanics, but maintainers must choose whether hiding intermediate reasoning and commentary by default is the intended product UX.

options.title: Adopt Turn Rollups
options.body: Review and land the paired PR after resolving conflicts and confirming terminal, recovery, and error behavior against current main.

options.title: Keep Activity Expanded
options.body: Retain the current transcript layout and close both items if full visibility is preferred over final-answer-first presentation.

options.title: Narrow the Rollup
options.body: Collapse only tool activity while leaving assistant commentary visible if commentary is considered part of the primary conversation.

recommendation.title: Adopt Turn Rollups
recommendation.body: Review and land the paired PR after resolving conflicts and confirming terminal, recovery, and error behavior against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current renderer split and proposed this exact UX, so he is best positioned to confirm the intended information hierarchy.
